title: Budget electronics
statementMd:
Find Electronics products priced under 50. Show name and price.

Expected columns: `name`, `price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' AND price < 50;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
